name: The Avesta & The Gathas
translation: The Gathas of Zarathustra — L.H. Mills & D.J. Irani

chapters.name: Ahunavaiti Gatha (Good Thoughts, Good Words, Good Deeds)
chapters.subtitle: Humata, Hukhta, Hvarshta — The Triple Path of Asha

verses.text: With hands outstretched in reverent prayer, I first beseech Thee, O Mazda, Most Benevolent Spirit, for the grace of Righteousness (Asha) in all deeds, and the wisdom of the Good Mind (Vohu Manah).
verses.original: ahiyâ yâsâ nemanghâ ustânazastô rafedhrayâ manyêush mazdâ pourvîm...

verses.text: Righteousness (Asha) is the highest good; it is illumination and bliss. Bliss comes to him who is righteous for the sake of the highest Righteousness alone.
verses.original: Ašem Vohû vahištem astî, uštâ astî, uštâ ahmâi hyat ašâi vahištâi ašem.
verses.transliteration: Ashem Vohu vahishtem asti, ushta asti, ushta ahmai...

verses.text: Humata, Hukhta, Hvarshta: Good Thoughts, Good Words, Good Deeds. Strive always to promote life, foster truth, and heal the world.
